title: A kismalac és a farkasok
titleEn: The Little Pig and the Wolves

video.huTitle: Magyar népmesék: A kismalac és a farkasok
video.enTitle: The Little Pig and the Wolves

summary.hu: A kismalac egyedül él az erdő közepén.
summary.en: The little pig lives alone in the middle of the forest.
summary.ro: Purcelușul trăiește singur în mijlocul pădurii.

summary.hu: Jön egy farkas, és meg akarja enni.
summary.en: A wolf comes and wants to eat him.
summary.ro: Vine un lup și vrea să-l mănânce.

summary.hu: A kismalac forró vizet önt a farkasra.
summary.en: The little pig pours hot water on the wolf.
summary.ro: Purcelușul toarnă apă fierbinte pe lup.

summary.hu: A farkas elszalad, és hívja a többi farkast.
summary.en: The wolf runs away and calls the other wolves.
summary.ro: Lupul fuge și îi cheamă pe ceilalți lupi.

summary.hu: A farkasok együtt jönnek, de nagyon gyávák.
summary.en: The wolves come together, but they're very cowardly.
summary.ro: Lupii vin împreună, dar sunt foarte fricoși.

summary.en: The little pig is clever and gets away.

questions.qEn: What does he pour on the wolf?
